sources.title: NASA Earth Observatory Drumlin Field in Northern Canada, Landsat8 OLI21June2014, published19March2015; USGS drumlin terminology
sources.license: NASA/USGS source image consulted-only; no pixels or measured terrain incorporated
sources.notes: Actual Landsat image inspected before freeze: long aligned streamlined ridges; overhead image does not independently measure vertical section. Low rounded elongated till-ridge form supported by USGS terminology https://apps.usgs.gov/thesaurus/term-simple.php?code=337&thcode=3 . https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1971/0074/report.pdf and https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/2004/1216/text.html directional end descriptions conflict; no directional claim used. Image https://assets.science.nasa.gov/dynamicimage/assets/science/esd/eo/images/imagerecords/85000/85506/drumlin_oli_2014172.jpg?w=1300 . Exact profile, footprint, dimensions and palette illustrative, not satellite-derived mesh.
